links.outcome: Clinician hypodensity detection accuracy (DICE score) with versus without AI assistance
links.effect: Clinician mean DICE 0.33 before vs 0.40 after AI-based HDT; adjusted increase 0.07 (95% CI 0.02-0.11, p=0.003). Trainees improved by 0.09.
links.quote: AI-based HDT use was associated with an increase of 0.07 (95% CI: 0.02-0.11, p = 0.003) in DICE score accounting for individual scan and clinician effects.

screen.reason: This is a reader study evaluating clinician accuracy before and after viewing AI-generated hypodensity detections on CT scans. It evaluates standard AI assistance rather than a specific deployment guardrail or organizational practice.
